description: Test suite for chat model reference helpers and resolution functions, verifying behaviors such as normalization, formatting, and resolution of chat model identifiers and catalog relations.

methods.name: buildChatModelOption
methods.description: Creates an option object with value and label for a given chat model catalog entry.

methods.name: createChatModelOverride
methods.description: Constructs a chat model override object from a raw model string.

methods.name: formatChatModelDisplay
methods.description: Formats a chat model reference into a display label, showing the model name and provider.

methods.name: normalizeChatModelOverrideValue
methods.description: Normalizes a chat model override value, resolving it to a qualified name if uniquely matchable.

methods.name: resolveChatModelOverride
methods.description: Resolves a chat model override to its value and origin source, indicating ambiguity if present.

methods.name: resolvePreferredServerChatModel
methods.description: Resolves the preferred chat model based on server, catalog, and fallbacks, prioritizing catalog matches.

methods.name: resolveServerChatModelValue
methods.description: Resolves a server-side chat model value, qualifying it with the provider if necessary.
